disposition_reason: Fourteen elements were measured by ICP-OES in 125 Egyptian weaning and breakfast food samples (25 product rows, dry weight), with a dry yeast detoxification experiment.

study.qa: Acid-washed glassware; no CRM, recovery or blanks reported
